designDecisionsAndRationale: One geometry: the canvas and the exporter call the same pcbViewModel in core; only number spelling differs (num = String on canvas, fmt in export) so canvas strings are unchanged (design 3, 9).

The dark board rect is always drawn over the union of rendered PCB element boxes; the page background (explicit or default) still fills the whole view box below it, so an explicit background is honoured outside the board and layer colours stay readable (design 5, user QA Q1).
PCB_BOARD_COLOR #2f4a3a is darker than every layer colour and lighter than PCB_HOLES_COLOR #202020 so non-plated holes stay visible (user QA Q3).
8-digit zone fills are split into fill plus fill-opacity (59 -> 0.35) for renderer compatibility (plan 03).
All PNG/PDF exports rasterise the renderPageSvg/renderSelectionSvg/renderArtboardSvg string, so fixing SVG fixes every format and host; no separate desktop test (design 1, 7).
intentionalTradeoffs: Exports use page-unit stroke widths, not vector-effect non-scaling-stroke; widths scale with PNG scale (design 9).
Export path data uses two-decimal fmt spelling; the canvas keeps JavaScript spelling (design 9).
Exports draw all layers regardless of the canvas Layers panel (design 6, user QA Q2).
Footprint bounds approximate stroke-text extents, so text outside its footprint box may sit partly outside the board rect (design 11, low).
supportedEdgeCases: Hidden footprint/board texts (hidden: true) and visual.hidden elements are not drawn (design 6).
pcb.board has a null box and contributes no primitives and no board box.
Arc tracks, all pad shapes, rotations and drill offsets, slot holes, vias with holes, translucent zone fills, back-side footprint graphics drawn before front side (shared model, design 3).
background: null (transparent) and explicit backgrounds such as #ffffff; selection and artboard exports apply the same board-rect rule over the rendered elements (design 5).
Pages without rendered PCB elements get no board rect, so bytes are unchanged (design 5).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Following transient hidden layers in exports (user QA Q2).
A user-selectable board colour or a flag to replace the board colour with the background (user QA Q1 alternative).
Boa vs TS rounding at an exact two-decimal boundary beyond the parity fixture (design 11, low).
residualRisks: Plan 03 board-rect test reason is wrong: four fixture pcb.graphic boxes are under 1 unit on one side and renderElementsSvg widens them to 1 unit (document.ts:166-176); the step5 reviewer confirmed the raw and widened page unions are both [-28.083,-138.22,1108.25,230.75], so the assertion holds. If it fails, the expected union in the test must use Math.max(1, width/height) widening; the rect must not be changed to match the test (step5 low finding, pcb-svg-03-svg-renderer.md:154).
User QA Q1 reading of an explicit background versus the board colour (low).
Native/TS fmt rounding-boundary mismatch in native parity (low); plan 04 records the first differing offset and routes it to plan 03 rather than weakening the comparison.
feat/canvas-theme may edit svg-export/document.ts near the background rect (low; merge-time conflict only).
